scripts.coverage: yarn recompile && forge coverage --report summary --report lcov --ir-minimum --ffi --match-path 'test/unit/*' --no-match-coverage test
scripts.deploy:layer-one:ethereum-mainnet: bash -c 'source .env && yarn recompile && forge script script/L1/DeployL1Contracts.s.sol:DeployL1Contracts --ffi --rpc-url ethereum_mainnet --account $ETHEREUM_MAINNET_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --verify --chain 1 -vvvvv'
scripts.deploy:layer-one:ethereum-sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && yarn recompile && forge script script/L1/DeployL1Contracts.s.sol:DeployL1Contracts --ffi --rpc-url ethereum_sepolia --account $ETHEREUM_SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --verify --chain 11155111 -vvvvv'
scripts.deploy:layer-three: bash -c 'source .env && yarn recompile && forge script script/L3/DeployL3Contracts.s.sol:DeployL3Contracts --ffi --rpc-url geo --account $GEO_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --verify --chain $GEO_CHAIN_ID --gas-estimate-multiplier 300 --slow -vvvvv'
scripts.deploy:layer-three:testnet: bash -c 'source .env && yarn recompile && forge script script/L3/DeployL3Contracts.s.sol:DeployL3Contracts --ffi --rpc-url geo_testnet --account $GEO_TESTNET_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --verify --chain $GEO_TESTNET_CHAIN_ID --gas-estimate-multiplier 300 --slow -vvvvv'
scripts.deploy:layer-two:arbitrum-one: bash -c 'source .env && yarn recompile && forge script script/L2/DeployL2Contracts.s.sol:DeployL2Contracts --ffi --rpc-url arbitrum_one --account $ARBITRUM_ONE_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --verify --chain 42161 -vvvvv'
scripts.deploy:layer-two:arbitrum-sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && yarn recompile && forge script script/L2/DeployL2Contracts.s.sol:DeployL2Contracts --ffi --rpc-url arbitrum_sepolia --account $ARBITRUM_SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --verify --chain 421614 -vvvvv'
scripts.test:invariant: yarn recompile && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=invariant_l2 forge test --ffi --match-contract 'L2ExecutionPaths|L2Invariants' -vvv && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=invariant_l3 forge test --ffi --match-contract 'L3ExecutionPaths|L3Invariants' -vvv
